name: B Capital — Monthly PitchBook Portfolio Sync
x-steps: 1. Load the 136-company portfolio list (slugs/names embedded from data/portfolio.json).

2. For each company re-pull the PitchBook profile: Investor Finder plugin-1777018662 (investors) + the public PitchBook company profile page (pitchbook.com/profiles/company/…) when retrievable; any field not retrieved is marked not_available — never fabricated.

3. Deliver the JSON payload to POST <API_BASE>/pitchbook/sync/webhook (X-Ingest-Secret / basic auth) which upserts libSQL pitchbook_profiles keyed by company_id with fetched_at UTC, source_url and the per-field availability map.
4. The backend schedules a Media snapshot backup (JSON) of the full durable store after every sync (scheduleBackup) — SHA-256 verified on fetch-back.
5. Per-field availability is recomputed on upsert so missing fields keep the explicit 'Not available in PitchBook' empty state in the UI.
6. Company sections stay server-rendered from the store with no Run button; the workflow only writes the store.
7. The backend appends a pitchbook_sync_runs row (run_id, started_at, finished_at UTC, companies_refreshed, fields_populated, empty_state_count, errors); GET /pitchbook/sync/runs lists them.
